details: Good starting point to expand the provider plan.

entries.label: Runtime Adapter Bridge
entries.summary: Recommended agent-to-agent connector for consistency and federation with external runtimes.
details: Governed connector to interoperate with external runtimes.

entries.label: AIGateway
entries.summary: Recommended routing gateway for scenarios with sidecars and provider observability.

entries.label: playwright-interactive
entries.summary: Recommended skill to debug web surfaces and browser automations interactively.
details: Good candidate to expand the Agent OS on desktop/web.

entries.label: figma-use
entries.summary: Suggested skill to make design-to-code and canvas writes part of the Zavorth operational ecosystem.

entries.label: filesystem
entries.summary: MCP server declared in the local manifest to expose files and workspaces; execution remains disabled until review.

entries.label: reasoning
entries.summary: MCP server declared in the local manifest for reasoning tools; execution remains disabled until review.

entries.label: playwright
entries.summary: MCP server declared in the local manifest for browser automation; execution remains disabled until review.

entries.label: Memory LanceDB
entries.summary: local vector DB for semantic memory search with embeddings and cosine similarity.
details: Backed by local JSON, configurable dimensions, multiple collections.

entries.label: Memory Honcho
entries.summary: Dialectic user modeling with profiles, preferences, traits, insights and conversation history.
details: Learns facts, extracts insights, tracks preferences across sessions.

entries.label: Diagnostics OpenTelemetry
entries.summary: Observability with spans, metrics and logs in the OpenTelemetry standard.
details: Spans with trace_id, counters, gauges, OTEL JSON export.

entries.label: Achievements
entries.summary: Gamification system with achievements, levels, streaks and leaderboard.
details: 16 achievements across 7 categories, 5 tiers, points and levels system.

entries.label: Skin Engine
entries.summary: Visual themes engine with built-in skins and custom skin installation.
details: 4 built-in skins (default, ares, mono, slate), preview, YAML/JSON export.

entries.label: Trajectory Research
entries.summary: Structured research with trajectories, evidence, citations, reports and export for training.
details: Structured methodology, quality scoring, Alpaca/ShareGPT/JSONL export.

entries.label: Active Memory
entries.summary: Active memory that decides what to remember/forget in real-time with importance decay and automatic consolidation.
details: Auto-eviction, categorization, relevance-based recall, interaction processing.

entries.label: Diagnostics Prometheus
entries.summary: Metrics export in Prometheus format with counters, gauges, histograms and HTTP server /metrics.
details: 20+ built-in metrics, labels, histogram buckets, /metrics and /health endpoints.

entries.label: Provider Novita AI
entries.summary: Access affordable open-source models via Novita API (Llama, Mistral, Qwen, Deepseek, Yi, Phi).

entries.label: Browser Playwright
entries.summary: Browser automation via Playwright with navigate, screenshot, extract, PDF and multi-tab.
details: Headless Chromium, selector-based extraction, PDF generation.

entries.label: Search Exa
entries.summary: Neural semantic search via Exa with findSimilar and getContents for deep research.
details: Neural, keyword and auto search. Categories: company, research, news, github, pdf.

entries.label: Kanban Dispatcher
entries.summary: SQLite-backed Kanban with multi-agent dispatcher, auto-blocking, prioritization and parallel dispatch.
details: Custom columns, automatic blocking, priority-based dispatch, max concurrent.

entries.label: Security Guidance
entries.summary: Interactive security policy lookup, OWASP Top 10, code scanning and hardening guide.
details: 15 built-in policies, check_code, audit_checklist, hardening guide.

entries.label: Provider Replicate
entries.summary: Replicate — run ML models in the cloud (Llama, SDXL, Whisper, hundreds of community models).

entries.label: Provider HuggingFace
entries.summary: HuggingFace Inference API — run open-source models directly (text, image, audio).
details: Llama, Mistral, SDXL, Whisper and more.

entries.label: Web Firecrawl
entries.summary: Firecrawl — advanced web scraping that converts pages to clean Markdown. Scrape, crawl, map and extract.
details: Clean Markdown, structured extraction, batch scrape.

entries.label: Image Gen fal.ai
entries.summary: fal.ai — image generation via API. FLUX, Stable Diffusion, and proprietary models.

entries.label: Search SearXNG
entries.summary: SearXNG — self-hosted private meta-search engine. Aggregates Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo without tracking.

entries.label: Video Gen Runway
entries.summary: Runway ML — video generation via API. Gen-3 Alpha Turbo, text-to-video and image-to-video.

entries.label: Spotify Player
entries.summary: Spotify — music control. Play, pause, skip, search, playlists, volume, devices.
details: Web API, now_playing, search, playlists, devices.

entries.label: Image Gen ComfyUI
entries.summary: ComfyUI — local and private image generation. Node-based workflow for SD, FLUX, custom models.
details: txt2img, img2img, inpaint, upscale. Run everything locally.

entries.label: Memory Qdrant
entries.summary: Qdrant — production-grade vector DB for semantic search with collections, filtering and CRUD.

entries.label: Disk Cleanup
entries.summary: Automatic disk cleanup with configurable rules, scan, dry-run and usage report.
details: 7 built-in rules, glob patterns, usage report.

entries.label: Codex Supervisor
entries.summary: Command execution supervision with timeout, retries, controlled concurrency and logging.
details: Max concurrent, timeout, auto-retry, stdout/stderr logging.

collections.label: Remote Gateways
collections.summary: Collection to expand cloud routing, multi-provider fallback and provider observability.
details: Curated pack for providers and cloud fallback.

collections.label: Agent Federation
collections.summary: Curated collection for consistency and federation with external runtimes on the same plane.
details: Good starting point for consistency and governed federation with external runtimes.

collections.label: UI Debug
collections.summary: Collection for browser automation, visual debugging and guided iteration in the web app.
details: Recommended path to strengthen Zavorth as a web-first Agent OS.

collections.label: Core MCP
collections.summary: Base collection to make MCP capabilities more explicit and operational in Zavorth.
details: Recommended path to mature the tool plane and reasoning plane.

collections.label: Design System
collections.summary: Collection for design-to-code, canvas writes and design system ops as part of the Zavorth ecosystem.
details: Natural path to bring Figma, skills and MCPs closer to the platform plane.

recipes.label: Remote Provider Rollout
recipes.summary: Guided recipe to sync remote gateways and complete the first external provider rollout.
steps: Sync the remote catalog to pull ecosystem updates.
Adopt the Remote Gateways collection in the platform plane.
Prepare the agent-to-agent connector for external consistency and federation.
details: Curated recipe for the initial rollout of the Zavorth remote ecosystem.

recipes.label: UI Debug Onboarding
recipes.summary: Recipe to make browser automation, visual debugging and playwright-first part of the platform plane.
steps: Mark the browser automation stack as trusted only after local smoke tests.
Take the path to the web app and CLI as the runtime confirms readiness.
details: Good path to reinforce Zavorth as an Agent OS with a strong web surface.

recipes.label: Core MCP Adoption
recipes.summary: Recipe to transform core MCPs into more operational capabilities in the product.
steps: Close the design system path when Figma and MCPs need to converge.
Use the plane to track trust and installation status of MCP servers.
details: Helps make the tool plane more explicit and closer to an operational marketplace.
